def solve(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])

    sep_row = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 1 for v in row))
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(m) if all(grid[i][j] == 1 for i in range(n)))

    top = sep_row
    left = sep_col

    tl = [row[:left] for row in grid[:top]]
    tr = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid[:top]]
    bl = [row[:left] for row in grid[sep_row + 1:]]
    br = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid[sep_row + 1:]]

    h = min(len(tl), len(tr), len(bl), len(br))
    w = min(len(tl[0]), len(tr[0]), len(bl[0]), len(br[0]))

    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]

            elif tr[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = tr[i][j]
            elif bl[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = bl[i][j]
            elif br[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = br[i][j]

    return out

def solve(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])

    sep_row = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 1 for v in row))
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(m) if all(grid[i][j] == 1 for i in range(n)))

    top = sep_row
    left = sep_col

    tl = [row[:left] for row in grid[:top]]
    tr = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid[:top]]
    bl = [row[:left] for row in grid[sep_row + 1:]]
    br = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid[sep_row + 1:]]

    h = min(len(tl), len(tr), len(bl), len(br))
    w = min(len(tl[0]), len(tr[0]), len(bl[0]), len(br[0]))

    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]

    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if tl[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = tl[i][j]
            elif tr[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = tr[i][j]
            elif bl[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = bl[i][j]
            elif br[i][j] != 0:
                out[i][j] = br[i][j]

    return out
